instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Implement the 'Parchment Cream' background globally. Use 'Tidiane Emerald' for all primary actions.
2. FONTS: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Lato' from Google Fonts immediately.
3. HERO SECTION: Create a 'Cinematic Spiritual' hero. Use the mosque image with a dark green gradient overlay (opacity 60%) so white text pops. Add a subtle 'Gold' border-bottom.
4. VIDEO GALLERY: Do NOT use a basic grid. Use a 'Bento' layout for the 'Featured' section (one large video on left, two smaller stacked on right). Use a standard responsive grid for the full list.
5. PLAYER: The video player page must feel like a cinema. Darken the background to #0a0a0a for this page only to focus on the content.
6. ISLAMIC TOUCHES: Add a 'Bismillah' (in Arabic calligraphy SVG or text) at the very top of the site, small and elegant.
7. SHADCN: Customize all Shadcn components to use rounded-xl and the Emerald/Gold palette. No default black/white borders.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., 'video-card-1', 'search-input', 'category-filter-gamou').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. No default Tailwind blue.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual. Spiritual design needs breathing room.
Micro-animations are mandatory. Hovering a video card should gently lift it and glow gold.
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays without a blur/solid backing.
